channel.title: Wisconsin Newspaper Association - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Wisconsin Newspaper Association (wnanews.com)

item.title: Trees Memorial Pylon Ceremony to remember 11 publishers | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: The Wisconsin Newspaper Association Foundation (WNAF) will honor 11 member publishers who passed away in 2024 and 2025 beginning at 11 a.m. on June 5, 2026 at the WNAF Memorial Publishers Pylon.

item.title: Wisconsin's ultimate April agritourism trail | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: With the ground thawing and the first blooms starting to pop up across Wisconsin, now is the perfect time to hit the state’s agritourism trail.

item.title: Wisconsin reporter Shelly Kittleson shares story of captivity in Iraq | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: Wisconsin journalist Shelly Kittleson, who was kidnapped and held captive for eight days earlier this year in Iraq, shared her story with The Atlantic magazine. Portions of it were republished April 23 in the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel and USA Today Network-Wisconsin.

item.title: Group gets help in records dispute with City of Janesville | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: SNOW Janesville is getting legal help from a nonprofit environmental advocacy organization after the group says the City of Janesville seeks to charge SNOW $1,000 for records about proposed data centers in Janesville.

item.title: Former Post-Crescent staffer David Horst Jr. dies | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: A May 2 Celebration of Life is scheduled to remember longtime Appleton Post-Crescent and Gannett writer and editor David J. Horst Jr. of Dale, WI, who died on Feb. 7, 2026 at age 69.

item.title: Who pays when a neighbor’s tree damages your property? | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: A strong storm rolls through. The next morning, a large branch — or an entire tree — is lying across your fence, driveway or roof. Who pays for the damage?

item.title: WANTED: Judges for North Carolina Press Association newspaper contest | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: WNAF is currently seeking volunteers to judge the North Carolina Press Association's annual newspaper contest.

item.title: Lecker moderates March 19 Women in Business panel | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: Wisconsin State Journal Executive Editor Kelly Lecker served as moderator for a special March 19 Women in Business panel in recognition of National Women’s Month at Two Brothers in Edgerton.

item.title: State Senate OK’s $14.6M debt service, NIL bill on 17-16 vote | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: In a rare moment of drama in the Senate on Tuesday, a bill that would give the UW-Madison athletics department millions to pay down debt and free up other money for revenue-sharing with players passed by a single vote that changed just as the legislation appeared doomed.

item.title: Local's guide to a 'Staycation' spring break | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: From family-friendly fun to outdoor escapes and charming small towns, there’s plenty right here in the Badger State to fill a spring break week of memories without going far from home.

item.title: Strengthening rural Wisconsin | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: Recently I attended the first Rural Policy Institute Summit held in Stevens Point, hosted by the Wisconsin Institute for Sustainable Technology at UW-Stevens Point. More than 100 people from rural partners around the state gathered to engage and collaborate in small group discussions.

item.title: Delafield town chair sues city, mayor over open meeting complaint | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: The chairman of the Town of Delafield has sued the Delafield Common Council and Mayor Tim Aicher over what he says is a violation of the state open meetings law, but also has three more complaints involving Delafield pending with the Waukesha County District Attorney’s Office.

item.title: Former editor close to publishing 'Centennial' book | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: Perry Hibner is tapping back into his newspaper roots in his next book, reporting on the impact of a TV series that was itself based on a novel.

item.title: Deleted photo in Kenosha raises public records law questions | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: A parent speaking at a recent Kenosha Unified School District Board of Education meeting raised concerns about transparency and student privacy after a Southport Elementary School teacher allegedly photographed a second grade class on a personal phone and sent the picture to another teacher.

item.title: News/Media Alliance partners with Bria AI to launch licensing agreement | Wisconsin Newspaper Association
item.description: News/Media Alliance has partnered with Bria to let NMA members opt into an AI licensing agreement that would see them compensated for the use of their content in AI systems.
